data.narrative:
Sunflower Labs is a Series B-stage drone and autonomous systems company that has raised $41.7M to date. The broader Drones & Autonomous sector comprises eight private peers, including Elroy Air, Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, and Joby Aviation, with no public comparables currently available.

The valuation analysis relied on a single applicable method due to peer-set constraints. The Stage-Progression approach applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier, typical for Series B advancement, to the company's $42M total raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $79M. A Peer-Median approach was not viable; while seven same-sector peers exist, none produced three or more datapoints within narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation tier), making sector-wide medians unreliably broad for frontier-tech positioning.

The triangulation supports a valuation range of $67M (low) to $91M (high), centered on $79M. This range reflects confidence bounds around the single stage-progression result rather than cross-method convergence. Key uncertainties include the reliability of the 1.9x multiplier for this specific subsector (autonomous hardware), the absence of recent Series B comparables in Drones & Autonomous, and execution risk inherent to pre-revenue or early-revenue frontier-tech. The analysis would benefit from additional same-stage private market transactions or public-market reference pricing as the sector matures.
